d: Wonder, surprise, delight … the key elements of attraction. And the ingredients that shall keep you listening to Daler Mehndi's latest offering Forceful, fearless, frank and flirtatious. Daler Mehndi's route map to musical monarchy is well-trodden. Still, it's one thing knowing India's greatest performer is all that and a whole other thing to hear that appetite and experience, that longing, across all these years he's been ruling the charts.
